en.text:
Applying certain buffs to allies grants 300% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Regeneration Rate for <pve 7 /> <pvp [3.5?] /> seconds.

Activation Triggers:
• Granting the <solar/>Cure, <solar/>Radiant, or <solar/>Restoration <solar/>Solar subclass buffs to allies
• Healing (from most sources), or reviving allies

Will NOT trigger <solar/>Ember of Benevolence:
Empowering Rifts, Mods, <yellow Crest of Alpha Lupi />'s Healing Pulse, Mothkeeper's Wraps Overshield Moth, Non-Solar Support Frame Auto Rifles
